convert_ace_step_weights: convert ACE-Step model weights to a diffusers pipeline format using checkpoint dir and output dir
run_convert_script_cli: run the ACE-Step to diffusers conversion script via argparse CLI with checkpoint, config, and output arguments
build_diffusers_pipeline: build a diffusers AceStepPipeline from converted ACE-Step checkpoint weights with transformer and condition encoder
split_model_weights: split ACE-Step model weights into transformer, condition encoder, audio tokenizer, and detokenizer sub-models
load_hf_hub_checkpoint: download an ACE-Step checkpoint from the Hugging Face Hub and convert it to a local diffusers pipeline
